scientific_scope_status: For C2 rank-one-convex F on R^{2x2}, compatible jets are B1=[[a,b],[d,e]], B2=[[b,c],[e,f]], equivalently B1 e2=B2 e1. Set E_F=sum_i D2F(A)[Bi,Bi]. The source derives, at every fixed A, an algebraic two-form omega_A with E_F+omega_A(B1,B2)>=0 for all compatible jets, by imported univariate PSD matrix-polynomial SOS and the six quadratic minor relations. No smooth, polynomial or globally closed selection follows. Closed polynomial forms are exact and may integrate away in the established heat-flow interface; pointwise completion alone cannot.
